resources.string: Optionally read foreground text and controls through accessibility alongside Shizuku or on-device ADB. Confirmation follows the Agent tool settings. Assisted actions have a separate switch below.
Click controls, enter text, scroll and navigate through accessibility while the selected Shizuku or ADB authority is available. Off by default; starts with a new run.

The Agent can operate other apps using visible controls and back, home or recents. Actions follow your Agent tool confirmation setting and can change app content. Shizuku or ADB must remain available. Turn this switch off to stop new actions.
Connected; follows the Agent tool confirmation setting
Enable Screen observation in system settings, then return. Some sideloaded installs require Allow restricted settings in app info.

When enabled, requested visible text and controls are sent to your configured model, following the Agent tool confirmation setting. Password fields are skipped, but pages may contain other personal information. You can turn this switch or the system service off at any time.
